category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly increase learning rate to 0.001 and dropout to 0.20. Larger updates may accelerate learning of sparse item representations, while stronger dropout may limit overfitting. Retain history length 128, hidden width 128, one GRU layer, existing loss and readout, and training caps. Existing predictor loading remains compatible.
